muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "POST /signals datastar(marshalJSON(Signals(ctx)))" -}}
{{- with .Header "X-Side" "effect" -}}{{- end -}}
rendered-output-to-discard
{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Sig struct {
	Count int `json:"count"`
}

// Signals is a non-streaming action that only updates client signals: the
// route responds application/json with the marshaled result as the Datastar
// signals body, and the define body executes for its side effects only.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Signals(_ context.Context) (Sig, error) {
	return Sig{Count: 7}, nil
}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/signals", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if got, want := rec.Header().Get("Content-Type"), "application/json"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("Content-Type = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if got, want := rec.Header().Get("X-Side"), "effect"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("X-Side = %q, want %q (define body must execute for side effects)", got, want)
	}
	if want := `{"count":7}`; rec.Body.String() != want {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
	}
	if strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "rendered-output-to-discard") {
		t.Errorf("body = %q; rendered output must be discarded on success", rec.Body.String())
	}
}
